hero.badge: Nguoi tien phong LASIK dau tien tai khu vuc Thai Binh Duong
hero.title: Thi luc, hoan hao
hero.subtitle: Phau thuat khuc xa theo yeu cau boi Bac si Charles Flowers, MD — nguoi tien phong LASIK dau tien tai khu vuc Thai Binh Duong.

procedures.title: Ba con duong den su ro rang

lasik.title: LASIK
lasik.description: Tao vat femtosecond khong dao voi dinh hinh lai bang excimer. Thu thuat 15 phut, thi luc ngay hom sau.

prk.title: PRK
prk.description: Cat bo be mat khong can vat giac mac. Ly tuong cho giac mac mong hoac loi song nang dong.

icl.title: ICL
icl.description: Thau kinh Collamer cay ghep cho don thuoc cuc cao. Co the dao nguoc, chong tia UV, vinh vien.

pioneer.title: Bac si Charles Flowers, MD
pioneer.paragraph1: Bac si Flowers da thuc hien cac thu thuat LASIK dau tien tai Guam, Saipan, Palau va Quan dao Marshall — mang phau thuat phuc hoi thi luc den cac cong dong Thai Binh Duong xa xoi chua bao gio duoc tiep can cham soc khuc xa.
pioneer.paragraph2: Ngay nay, tinh than tien phong do van thuc day moi thu thuat tai Atelier. Hon 30.000 ca phau thuat thanh cong. Ty le hai long cua benh nhan 99,2%. Su chinh xac cua mot nghe nhan ap dung cho mon qua thi luc.

whyAtelier.title: Duoc tao ra voi su chinh xac

wavefront.title: Ban do mat song tuy chinh
wavefront.description: Moi mat la duy nhat. Chung toi tao ban do dia hinh giac mac cua ban de huong dan dieu tri laser voi do chinh xac duoi micron.

expertise.title: Chuyen mon da duoc thu nghiem tai Thai Binh Duong
expertise.description: Bac si Flowers da mai giua ky nang cua minh trong dieu kien kho khan tren cac hon dao xa xoi. Benh nhan Los Angeles duoc huong loi tu chieu sau kinh nghiem do.

consultations.title: Tu van trong cung tuan
consultations.description: Khong co danh sach cho. Danh gia toan dien, danh gia trung thuc ve tinh du dieu kien va con duong ro rang phia truoc trong vai ngay.

testimonial.quote: Toi thuc day sang hom sau va co the doc dong ho o ben kia phong. Sau hai muoi nam doi kinh, no cam giac nhu mot phep la.
testimonial.author: Sarah M., benh nhan LASIK, 2024

cta.title: Buoi tu van cua ban dang cho
cta.subtitle: Danh gia 90 phut de xac dinh tinh du dieu kien, lap ban do giac mac va thiet ke ke hoach dieu tri phu hop voi mat cua ban.
